correctness.rationale: Final assessment of the complete replacements in /workspace/repairs/5/: the all-q theorem is retained. Frozen RESULT.md overclaimed that the exact Fano unit pivots independently recover the wedge homotopy type. They cancel free chain groups over Z, not geometric cells; they do not compute pi1. The repair narrows that evidence to integral homology, states that the representation acts before taking the quotient, and records the actual Fano computation and selected difference sets. For the final proof, the cover by the point simplex U and the union V of closed line stars is invariant. For any nonempty face sigma of V the set A(sigma) of lines meeting every point of sigma is nonempty, contains its line part, and reverses inclusions. In each barycentric prism over a chain sigma_0<...<sigma_k, the bottom-prefix/top-suffix interpolation has support in the face sigma_i union A(sigma_i); this proves a well-defined equivariant contraction via the full line simplex. Subcomplex cofibrations give the homotopy pushout, hence an equivariant unreduced suspension with fixed poles. Thus ordinary orbits can be taken on the suspension model. Distinct line simplices share only vertices, so free-face removals with equivariantly chosen line centers leave Nq distinct edges on N vertices, connected by the plane axiom for every point pair. Edge and vertex stabilizers in this graph are trivial, yielding a q-rose quotient and a regular graph covering, not a regular covering on X_q. A pair p,tp on some line transports to a pair on the base line; use its first point as center. Over Z[C_N] one boundary entry is then t-1 and every other entry is its multiple, so invertible column operations split off q-1 free summands. The kernel of multiplication by t-1 consists of the constant coefficient vectors; suspension is natural on reduced integral homology and yields the announced module. Independently checked the q=2 orbit-cell vector: for faces of size k the two subdivided shores contribute 2*(C(7,k) with k<7 + C(7,k-1)); mixed faces have at least one singleton shore and contribute 7*C(3,k-1) plus its other-shore copy except when k=2, when count once. Apart from the two fixed new vertices, all these faces have seven-element orbits; this gives (4,11,22,22,16,8,2). Inspected verify.py including its signed quotient boundaries and integral pivots, without executing it. Rechecked the replacement theorem, proof and verification description; the analytic proof establishes both wedge equivalences and the lattice.

value.rationale: The repaired result resolves the natural ordinary symmetry quotient of a canonical bipartite independence complex, with an explicit geometric reason that the quotient is simply connected despite the Singer action. The separate regular-plus-trivial integral lattice refines both the unquotiented sphere count and the quotient invariant and is useful for integral equivariant comparisons. It is not a small numerical case or a rational rank restatement. The correction removes an unsupported computational homotopy claim without weakening either mathematically proved result.
